title: Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report
paper_type_zh: 前沿多模态模型技术报告与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 需要审计多模态推理、视觉 agent 训练对象、SFT/DPO 与数据披露边界的读者
one_line: Qwen2.5-VL partially discloses 4.1T-scale multimodal training, a roughly 2M-entry SFT mixture, filtering, rejection-sampled reasoning, and SFT/DPO, while withholding reusable data, reward, lineage, and audit artifacts.
Qwen2.5-VL 部分披露了 4.1T 规模多模态训练、约 200 万条 SFT 混合数据、过滤、拒绝采样推理与 SFT/DPO，但未公开可复用数据、reward、lineage 或审计工件。
why: It is a concrete frontier disclosure case: source categories and pipeline interfaces are reported, but enough prompt-, filter-, reward-, and provenance-level detail is absent that the model release and agent capability cannot be treated as a reproducible reasoning-data recipe.
inclusion_reason: A frontier multimodal report that unusually discloses aggregate scale, source categories, construction steps, SFT/DPO use, rejection sampling, reward-model filtering, and partial agent-trajectory creation while leaving the reusable data, reward, and audit artifacts unavailable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier model reports can identify stages, aggregate training scale, or benchmark capability without exposing the data and feedback objects needed to audit or reproduce post-training. For a multimodal visual agent, a model release and an agent benchmark result are not by themselves evidence of released trajectories, executable environments, reward contracts, or data provenance.

Qwen2.5-VL is useful for this disclosure question because the official report gives more than a capability narrative: it describes training data categories, selected construction procedures, filtering, rejection sampling, and SFT/DPO. The same report still withholds the source inventories, record-level data, filter/reward artifacts, and audit evidence that would make those descriptions a reusable recipe.

前沿模型报告可能披露训练阶段、聚合训练规模或基准能力，但不公开审计或复现后训练所需的数据与反馈对象。对于多模态视觉 agent，模型发布和 agent 基准结果本身并不证明其轨迹、可执行环境、reward 合约或数据来源已被公开。

Qwen2.5-VL 对这一披露问题很有价值，因为官方报告不仅叙述能力，也描述了训练数据类别、部分构造流程、过滤、拒绝采样与 SFT/DPO。但同一报告仍未公开源数据清单、记录级数据、filter/reward 工件和审计证据，因此这些描述不能被当作可复用 recipe。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The report is a partial training-disclosure ledger rather than a data release. It states a 4.1T-token model configuration and reports pre-training categories spanning cleaned raw-web and synthesized multimodal material. It also describes a roughly 2M-entry SFT mixture, a two-stage filtering pipeline, expected-answer-gated rejection sampling for reasoning tasks, and SFT followed by DPO.

The relevant data objects differ by stage: multimodal QA, document HTML with coordinates, grounding annotations, video captions/timestamps, agent screenshots and actions, preference examples, and selected reasoning candidates. Feedback ranges from an expected-answer match to rule-based and model-based filters and preference training. The report does not release a common record schema, the underlying samples, the trained reward models, or the retained/rejected sets.

该报告是一份部分训练披露台账，而不是数据发布。报告给出 4.1T token 的模型配置，并说明预训练数据包括清洗后的 raw web 与合成多模态材料。它还描述了约 200 万条的 SFT 混合数据、两阶段过滤、针对推理任务且由预期答案把关的拒绝采样，以及先 SFT 后 DPO 的后训练。

不同阶段的数据对象包括多模态 QA、带坐标的文档 HTML、grounding 标注、视频字幕与时间戳、agent 截图和动作、偏好样本以及被选中的推理候选。反馈从预期答案匹配到规则过滤、模型过滤和偏好训练不等。报告没有发布统一记录 schema、底层样本、训练后的 reward model 或保留/拒绝集合。

title: Method
方法
html:
The report initializes the language component from Qwen2.5 and trains a redesigned ViT from scratch. Its three pre-training stages list 1.5T, 2T, and 0.6T tokens. The disclosed pre-training categories include image captions, interleaved image-text, OCR, visual knowledge, multimodal academic questions, grounding, document parsing, video, and agent interactions. For interleaved data, it reports standard cleaning followed by four internal scoring dimensions; source identities, score implementation, thresholds, and yields are not given.

The report describes constructed grounding material with public and proprietary data, formats such as XML and JSON, and synthesis using Grounding DINO and SAM. It describes synthetic document HTML that includes layout boxes, OCR data that mixes synthetic, open, and in-house material, one million synthetic chart samples, six million table samples filtered by an offline table-recognition model, and long-video captions synthesized from multiple frames. These are project-level disclosures, not released corpora or complete source manifests.

For agent material, mobile, web, and desktop screenshots receive synthetic captions and UI grounding annotations. Multi-step trajectories from open-source data and an agent framework on virtual environments are reformatted into a shared function-call action space. Human and model annotators write a reasoning explanation for each highlighted ground-truth action from the global query and before/after screenshots; a model filter removes low-quality reasoning. The report does not identify every environment, annotator, record, replay state, or task-success predicate.

Post-training reports approximately two million SFT entries, split evenly by entry count between pure text and multimodal data. Queries come primarily from open-source repositories with curated purchased and online-query additions. Qwen2-VL-Instag categorizes QA pairs into eight domains and 30 subcategories, after which rule-based and Qwen2.5-VL reward-model filters score examples. For rejection sampling, an intermediate Qwen2.5-VL candidate is retained only when its output matches a ground-truth expected answer, then receives additional rule/model checks. SFT is followed by DPO on image-text and pure-text preference data with the ViT frozen; preference sources and criteria are unknown.

报告将语言组件初始化为 Qwen2.5，并从头训练重新设计的 ViT。其三个预训练阶段分别列出 1.5T、2T 和 0.6T token。披露的预训练类别包括图像字幕、交错图文、OCR、视觉知识、多模态学术问题、grounding、文档解析、视频和 agent 交互。对于交错图文数据，报告称先进行标准清洗，再按四个内部评分维度打分；源数据身份、评分实现、阈值和保留率未披露。

报告还描述了使用公开和 proprietary 数据、XML/JSON 等格式，以及 Grounding DINO 与 SAM 合成的 grounding 材料；带 layout box 的合成文档 HTML；混合合成、开放与内部材料的 OCR 数据；100 万条合成图表样本；经离线表格识别模型过滤的 600 万条表格样本；以及由多帧合成的长视频字幕。这些是项目级披露，并非已发布的语料或完整 source manifest。

对于 agent 材料，移动端、网页和桌面截图获得合成 caption 和 UI grounding 标注。来自开源数据和虚拟环境中 agent framework 的多步轨迹被重构为共享的 function-call action space。人工与模型标注者根据全局 query、操作前后截图和高亮的 ground-truth action，为每一步写出 reasoning explanation；模型 filter 会移除低质量 reasoning。报告未列出所有环境、标注者、记录、可回放状态或任务成功 predicate。

后训练报告约 200 万条 SFT 样本，按条目数计纯文本和多模态各占一半。query 主要来自开源仓库，并加入经整理的购买数据与线上 query。Qwen2-VL-Instag 先将 QA 对分类为 8 个 domain、30 个子类，随后规则 filter 与 Qwen2.5-VL reward model 对样本打分。拒绝采样中，中间版本 Qwen2.5-VL 的候选输出只有在匹配 ground-truth expected answer 时才被保留，之后还经过额外的规则/模型检查。SFT 后进行 DPO，使用图文与纯文本偏好数据且冻结 ViT；偏好来源和标准未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official report supplies the central disclosure evidence: Table 1 lists 4.1T trained tokens; Table 2 lists 1.5T, 2T, and 0.6T across visual, multimodal, and long-context pre-training; and §2.3.1 states that SFT contains approximately two million entries. Sections 2.2 and 2.3 identify construction and selection interfaces, including internal scoring, synthetic generation, reward-model filtering, ground-truth matching, and DPO.

The report also evaluates the 72B model on multimodal, document, video, and GUI-agent benchmarks. These results support the claim that the authors tested the released system across those surfaces. They do not validate the provenance, licensing, calibration, rejection policy, or reproducibility of the underlying training objects.

官方报告提供了核心披露证据：Table 1 列出 4.1T 个训练 token；Table 2 列出视觉、多模态和长上下文预训练阶段的 1.5T、2T 和 0.6T；§2.3.1 说明 SFT 包含约 200 万条样本。§2.2 与 §2.3 识别了构造和选择接口，包括内部评分、合成生成、reward-model 过滤、ground-truth 匹配与 DPO。

报告还在多模态、文档、视频和 GUI-agent 基准上评估了 72B 模型。这些结果支持作者在这些评测面上测试了发布系统的说法，但不能证明底层训练对象的来源、许可证、calibration、拒绝策略或可复现性。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For this atlas, the notable contribution is the combination of a model report with several concrete data-pipeline interfaces. The report connects multimodal pre-training categories to document, video, grounding, and agent objects; it names construction tools and some counts; and it states filtering and post-training stages rather than only reporting model capabilities.

That disclosure remains partial. Its value is therefore not an open data recipe, nor evidence that an agent capability is itself a released trajectory dataset. It is a comparatively detailed case for mapping what a frontier report says about data and feedback against what remains unavailable for independent audit.

对本 atlas 而言，值得关注的贡献是该模型报告与若干具体数据 pipeline 接口的结合。报告将多模态预训练类别连接到文档、视频、grounding 和 agent 对象；列出构造工具及部分数量；并说明过滤和后训练阶段，而非只报告模型能力。

这种披露仍是部分的。因此，它的价值不是开放数据 recipe，也不是 agent 能力本身已经构成已发布轨迹数据集的证据。它是一个较详细的案例，可用来对照前沿报告披露了哪些数据与反馈信息，以及独立审计还缺少什么。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The report does not release training data, a dataset manifest, record schemas, retained/rejected samples, reward-model weights, or preference pairs. It does not name the raw-web, proprietary, purchased, and most open-source sources, nor provide mixture weights, source rights, per-source counts, splits, deduplication, or decontamination results.

The reward-model and answer-matching mechanisms are only described at a high level. Their training data, calibration, thresholds, failure rates, and susceptibility to shortcut optimization are unknown. Agent training material is likewise incomplete for reuse: virtual environments, environment versions, state resets, action predicates, annotation coverage, and replay information are not specified. Reported benchmarks cannot attribute gains to a particular construction stage or verify that the hidden training data is auditable.

报告未发布训练数据、dataset manifest、记录 schema、保留/拒绝样本、reward-model 权重或偏好对。它没有列出 raw web、proprietary、购买数据和大多数开源来源的名称，也没有提供 mixture weight、来源权利、逐来源数量、split、去重或去污染结果。

reward model 与答案匹配机制只在高层描述。它们的训练数据、calibration、阈值、失败率和对 shortcut optimization 的脆弱性均未知。agent 训练材料同样无法直接复用：虚拟环境、环境版本、状态重置、动作 predicate、标注覆盖和 replay 信息均未说明。报告的基准结果不能将收益归因于某一构造阶段，也不能验证隐藏训练数据是否可审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this report to study how a multimodal frontier system turns heterogeneous objects into post-training material: ground-truth-checked reasoning candidates, model-filtered QA, preference examples, and partially described agent trajectories. It is particularly useful for separating disclosed selection interfaces from released supervision artifacts.

For builders, the report offers hypotheses to investigate, not a directly reproducible dataset. A responsible replication would need to define source rights, prompt and action schemas, exact filters, answer matching, reward calibration, trajectory environments, splits, and decontamination before treating its descriptions as a training recipe.

可用该报告研究多模态前沿系统如何把异质对象转化为后训练材料：经 ground-truth 检查的推理候选、经模型过滤的 QA、偏好样本和部分描述的 agent 轨迹。它尤其适合区分已经披露的选择接口与真正发布的 supervision 工件。

对构建者来说，报告提供的是值得检验的假设，而不是可直接复现的数据集。若要负责任地复现，必须先定义来源权利、prompt 与 action schema、精确 filter、答案匹配、reward calibration、轨迹环境、split 和去污染，然后才能将这些描述视为训练 recipe。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §2.2.1 before interpreting the 4.1T figure: it distinguishes data categories and a few construction details but not a source manifest.
  • Compare the SFT filter in §2.3.2 with the rejection sampler in §2.3.3: one uses a model/rule quality gate, while the other explicitly requires an expected-answer match.
  • Treat the agent-data paragraph as a partial description of training objects, not proof of a released environment or trajectory corpus.
  • Use Tables 1–2 for scale disclosure and Tables 3–9 only as evaluation evidence; neither substitutes for data lineage, reward calibration, or contamination evidence.

• 解读 4.1T 数字前先读 §2.2.1：它区分了数据类别并提供少量构造细节，但并不是 source manifest。
  • 对照 §2.3.2 的 SFT filter 与 §2.3.3 的拒绝采样：前者使用模型/规则质量门，后者明确要求匹配 expected answer。
  • 将 agent data 段落视为训练对象的部分描述，而非已发布环境或轨迹语料的证明。
  • 用 Tables 1–2 阅读规模披露，用 Tables 3–9 仅作评测证据；二者均不能替代 data lineage、reward calibration 或 contamination 证据。
